column3: OBJECTS AND THE APPLICATION OF THE PROVISIONS OF THE ACT
The objects  of the Act shall be—

(a)
to  prevent  match  fixing,  corruption,  illegal
manipulation and illegal betting in sports;
to  exchange  information  relating  to  match
illegal  betting  in  sports  and  promote  best

(c)
to  conduct  programs  in  order  to  promote
awareness on issues relating to match fixing,
betting  in  sports  and  improve  coordination
